breaks.quote: Then one day Melvin makes the mistake that costs him.
breaks.why: The paragraph before says he did nothing wrong and the hazing already ended in acceptance, so this new 'mistake' arrives with no link and contradicts the story.

breaks.quote: So why does it still shout at you at 2am, 20 years later?
breaks.why: The paragraph before lists three stories, so the reader cannot tell what 'it' refers to.

breaks.quote: In humans, we sometimes make that mistake at 15.
breaks.why: The reader has just been told about two lessons, not a mistake, so 'that mistake' has no clear referent.
